description: "Redirecting voucher spending to public schools is a must, but that won't catapult us out of our low funding problem. No other candidate proposes measures to truly solve our education crisis, because no one wants to tell you that we need to raise taxes. I'll tell you the hard truths and offer solutions that make them easy to bare: we can do this without costing you a dime. Through a cannabis tax and two taxes on the ultra rich, we can fund education and care work for generations."
